idea-plugin.name: Piwi
idea-plugin.description:
Your Playwright suite's history in the IDE, from a Piwi instance:
  • the failures of the latest CI run on the checked-out branch, at their failing lines, with the recommended locator heal as a quick fix, the trace and the screenshot one action away;
  • the tests behind each locator line and each application file, and each test's pass rate;
  • brittle locators, and the locators an unsaved change breaks, with quick fixes;
  • the latest run in the status bar, and Piwi's MCP server for your AI assistant;
  • locators and recorded flows sent from the Piwi Picker browser extension, inserted at the caret.
Works in WebStorm, IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate, Rider and the other IDEs with the LSP API and JavaScript support.
